result.reason: The revision meets the fallback position: it limits inspections to once in any rolling 12-month period, retains 30 days' notice and business-hours access, and requires HDI to bear all costs, which is more Customer-favorable than the fallback's 15-day notice and 10% underpayment exception. It does not reach the preferred position because the inspector need not be independent or confidentiality-bound and direct systems access is not expressly prohibited. The change is minimal and preserves the existing commercial scope, though the inherited formulation “may ... have the right” and comma placement are awkward.
